result.instructions: Tools for PrintPoss, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my orders are still in production, and which have shipped?"; "List my products and the variant ids for iPhone 15 cases."; "Create a sample order to my own address for the Holoframe case.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes PrintPoss data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run printposs_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run printposs_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run printposs_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. printposs_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: printposs_list_stores
tools.title: List stores
tools.description: List the seller's connected stores (for example Shopify or Etsy shops). Use a store id as store_id when creating an order. GET /api/v1/seller/stores.

tools.name: printposs_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the print-on-demand products with their variants (device model, colour, product_variant_id). Use a product_variant_id from this list in printposs_create_order. GET /api/v1/seller/products.

tools.name: printposs_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List the seller's fulfillment orders with status (order_status, payment_status), external_order_id and totals. GET /api/v1/seller/orders.

include.description: Comma-separated relationships to include: items, packages, costs, refunds (for example 'items,packages').

tools.name: printposs_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order by its PrintPoss order_number, with optional items, packages (tracking), costs and refunds. GET /api/v1/seller/orders/{order_number}.

order_number.description: The PrintPoss order number (for example PP26020572410, from printposs_list_orders).

include.description: Comma-separated relationships to include: items, packages, costs, refunds (for example 'items,packages').

tools.name: printposs_list_wallet_transactions
tools.title: List wallet transactions
tools.description: List wallet transactions (top-ups, order payments, refunds) with balance_after. Use it to check spend per order. GET /api/v1/seller/wallet-transactions.

q.description: Search in the transaction description (for example an order number).

tools.name: printposs_get_webhook_setup
tools.title: Get webhook setup
tools.description: Read which webhook events (order.shipped, package.in_transit, package.delivered) are set up and their URLs. The header secret is not shown. GET /api/v1/seller/webhooks.

tools.name: printposs_create_order
tools.title: Create a fulfillment order
tools.description: Create a print-on-demand order that PrintPoss prints and ships to the buyer. It charges the seller's PrintPoss wallet and cannot be cancelled by this tool. Use a unique external_order_id: a repeated id is rejected, so a retry cannot double-charge. Get product_variant_id from printposs_list_products and use is_sample=true for a sample order to yourself. Orders with a seller-made shipping label (shipping_label_url) and Amazon FBA orders are not supported here. POST /api/v1/seller/orders.

external_order_id.description: Your own order id. Must be unique in your PrintPoss account.

design_image_url.description: Public URL of the design image.

mockup_image_url.description: Public URL of the mockup image.

region.description: State or region code for the country (for example CA for California).

is_sample.description: True for a sample order (for example to test quality).
